verdict.rationale: Clerky is a legal-paperwork platform where users sign documents (per the Partner API docs), so bulk-sending one document to many recipients is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence covers real-time collaboration, inviting collaborators, attorney review, and issuing SAFEs, stock, and options, but nothing describes sending the same document to many recipients in a single batch. Inviting collaborators to a document set is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
